interpretation.plain_speak: For earliest-deadline scheduling, the nominal knobs collapse to one effective quantity: how many corrective actions are actually reachable before the window closes. Two reachable actions, three reachable actions, and so on give the same failure count no matter which tested budget/onset/throughput combination produced them.
interpretation.north_star_question: Produces a compact fixed-resource law for when bounded correction can physically be deployed in time.
interpretation.next_stage: hold the reachable-budget law fixed and replicate it on held-out rotations and arm permutations to test topology transfer
